# Setup

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Setup ------------------------------------------------------------
source("Analysis.R")
df_snr <- load_sim("../results/snrDGP2correct.csv.gz")
summ_snr <- summarise_sim(df_snr) |>
  mutate(stf = factor(strength, sort(unique(strength))))
```

# Increasing SNR

```{r}
dfm <- summ_snr
snr_extra <- list(facet_wrap(~n, nrow = 1, labeller = lab_n),
                  labs(x = "strength"))
# RMSE | |Bias| vs strength, faceted by n
for (oc in c("linear", "quad1")) print(panel(dfm, oc, x = stf, extra = snr_extra))
# bal0 vs oracle
for (oc in c("linear", "quad1")) print(
  panel(dfm, oc, x = stf, ests = c("balnet0", "oracle_hajek", "oracle_ht"),
        extra = snr_extra))
#- table -#
perf_table(dfm, cols = c("strength", "n"),
           span_lab = \(x) paste0("strength = ", x), span_desc = FALSE,
           group = "outcome", title = "SNR grid, iid, correct spec (c = 1)")
#- MSE decomp -#
for (oc in c("linear", "quad1")) print(
  decomp_plot(filter(dfm, outcome == oc), x = strength, cols = n,
              xlab = "strength",
              x_scale = scale_x_continuous(trans = "log2",
                                           breaks = c(0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4)),
              title = paste("MSE Decomposition (%) \u2014", oc_labs[oc])))
#- extreme estimates -#
extreme_heat(dfm, "glmnetcv_hajek", x = strength, xlab = "strength",
             x_desc = FALSE)
```

- bal0 outperforms again

- Bal.CV, slightly outperforms glmnet with n increeases.

- bal05, bal10 are outperformed by MLE with increases in SNR.

Under linear outcomes: Increased confounding doesnt effect bal0.

Under quadratic outcomes: bal0 also degrades with SNR increases.
